svg.title: Gizmo: Rust to Green
svg.desc: Gremlin Gizmo stands flickering and cackling. The one dim tip on his inner end blinks green. He stops and glares up at it. It lights and holds. He clamps down and shakes hard to stamp it out, the tip goes dark, and he cackles again. Then it flares white and stays green, and green begins to climb back through him in hard steps. He thrashes. His lower bends pop round with a white flash and rust flakes drop off. The rust pushes back and the green loses ground while he hunches and cackles weakly. The green surges. His crooked top snaps back into a clean curve, his right eye shrinks and turns white, and one brow smooths out. Green runs down his outer side as he watches it go. The last kink pops straight, his left eye clears, and he is Gizmo with a rusty foot. He looks down at it, shakes like a wet dog, and the last flakes fly off. He blinks twice, looks himself over left and right, gives one small bounce, and settles into his neutral pose. Ten seconds on a transparent background.
